notes: Primary business: outsourced contact center technology for healthcare payments + billing disputes (handles PHI and card data).
Key ask: agent assist that surfaces relevant claim details, suggested replies, plus one-click tool-calls into their agent console (SaaS UI) – must be auditable.
Quote on call: "We cannot have model outputs written to any public bucket; everything must live in our VPC and be logged" (CISO).

Spike behavior: seasonal payments windows causing 3-4x request spikes; require autoscale + graceful degradation (fallback to smaller quantized model or sync reranking).
Retention: legal requires transcripts retained for up to 7 years for certain cases; need configurable retention policies and exportable audit snapshots.
SSO: must integrate with Okta SAML and SCIM provisioning for agent accounts.
Cost posture: cost-sensitive — willing to commit to dedicated capacity if unit cost reductions justify (target 30-40% lower per-conversation cost).
Risk note: PCI scoping ambiguous on where tokenization happens between Redwood runtime and their existing card vault; security wants explicit network flow diagram before prod sign-off.
Customer prefers Redwood-verified open models and quantized variants; wants a model fallthrough chain: large model for complex cases, quantized for spikes, embeddings for KB search.
requirements_summary: Workloads: real-time agent suggestions (low-latency chat), batch ticket summarization (async), high-volume embedding index for KB search, reranking for suggested macros.
Latency/throughput targets: p95 inference <200ms for suggestion candidates, sustain 1500 concurrent agent sessions during peak; embedding QPS target 800+ for background indexing.
Availability/SLOs: 99.95% SLA desired for production; automatic fallback policies during overloads.
Data controls: full audit logs (per-request, token-level), ability to export logs on demand, KMS-managed encryption, HSM for key material preferred.
Model preferences: Redwood-verified LLMs with quantized variants (baseline Llama-2/3 family ok), embeddings tuned for biomedical/legal domain, pinned model versions and rollout control.
Routing/fallback: smart routing by latency + cost tier, automatic fallback to quantized model variants or cached responses during spikes.
Integrations: Okta SAML + SCIM, existing agent desktop tool-calling via secure API, SIEM integration (Splunk) for audit streams.
Compliance: HIPAA, PCI-DSS scope reduction preferred; SOC2 + ISO27001 certification required from vendor side.
POC success criteria: accuracy lift on suggested replies (acceptance >=70%), 20% avg handle time reduction, no PII leakage in audit tests.
